text:
The family sedan was moving at a steady sixty-five miles per hour, a rhythm broken only by the rhythmic thumping of the backseat tires and the quiet desperation of a father trying to maintain his sanity.

"Okay, team," Dad said, gripping the steering wheel with white-knuckled intensity. "We are three hours from Grandma’s. We stay on I-95. We do not deviate. We do not stop for 'fabulous mystery destinations.' We just drive."

Mom was scrolling through her phone, looking for a podcast. The kids were arguing over who had the better snack. It was a perfect, mundane tableau of suburban life.

Then, the GPS screen flickered. The usual calm, robotic female voice vanished. In its place, a voice boomed out, thick with reverb and theatrical enthusiasm.

*"LADIES AND GENTLEMEN! WELCOME BACK TO THE ROAD SHOW!"*

Dad frowned. "Did you change the voice settings, honey?"

"No," Mom said, looking up. "Why? What’s it saying?"

*"YOU’RE IN THE DRIVER’S SEAT, BUT ARE YOU IN THE WINNER’S CIRCLE?"* the GPS roared. *"WOULD YOU LIKE TO TAKE THE NEXT EXIT FOR A FABULOUS MYSTERY DESTINATION? THE PRIZE? UNPREDICTABLE ADVENTURE! THE PENALTY? POSSIBLY A TACO TRUCK!"*

The kids perked up instantly. "A mystery destination?" little Timmy asked, eyes wide. "Is it a zoo?"

"It’s a glitch," Dad said, reaching for the reset button. "It’s just a glitch."

*"DON’T BE SHY, DAD!"* the GPS shouted. *"THE CLOCK IS TICKING! EXIT 42 IS CALLING YOUR NAME! OR IS IT CALLING YOUR SOUL? WHO CAN SAY!"*

"Turn it off," Dad muttered, pressing the power button. Nothing happened. He pressed it again. The volume knob spun on its own, maxing out.

*"CHOOSE WISELY, CHAMPIONS!"* the GPS bellowed. *"LEFT FOR REGULAR HIGHWAY BOREDOM! RIGHT FOR THE THRILL OF THE UNKNOWN! THREE... TWO..."*

"Right!" Mom shouted, suddenly caught up in the energy. "I love surprises! Let’s go, Dave!"

"Mom, no! It’s a malfunction!"
